reason: The facts hold. Round 43's '4 003' was an LB-row count: round43/scan_browser.notes.md l.3 has 16:15Z LB '4,003 teams (was 3,999)', and l.11 has the Overview at 16:19Z = 4,000 teams. In round 44 the LB showed rows to 4,005 at ~17:15Z (scan_browser.notes.md l.3), and the Overview showed 4,003 teams at 17:17:53Z (scan_plancheck.notes.md l.6; the plancheck LB text had no team total). R44-PC-01's '4,003 (= 16:15Z)' therefore compares the Overview count with round 43's LB-row count. The like-for-like LB figure is 4 005. Rank #154, the block ending at #158 and '5th from the bottom' are the same in both round-44 reads. Feasibility: readtime.sh l.53 uses ${RANKBODY:-default}, so an override set in the same Bash call works. cardfix44.py's bad-token regex ('#141|3 994|14:45 МСК|#148|17 из 22') and its single-'Мы на ЛБ (Chrome'-line assert pass either way. The change affects card text only: 0 Kaggle calls, no effect on the finals, decision B or R1-R10, and it is not a closed line. One nit: the 4,005 read was at ~17:15Z (20:15 MSK), while the default RANKSRC says 20:14 МСК (the plancheck LB read at 17:14:40Z), so there is a 1-minute label mismatch if only RANKBODY is overridden.
fix: Optional, cosmetic. In the same Bash call that sources r44dry/readtime.sh and runs cardfix (shell state does not persist between calls), set RANKBODY="#154 из 4 005, лучший паблик 0.959, 5-е снизу в блоке 0.959 (блок до #158)." and, for an exact label, RANKSRC="Chrome 20:15 МСК". Leaving the defaults ('20:14 МСК ... из 4 003') is also acceptable, since the count moves by a few teams per hour and the rank is what matters. Log the resulting card sha8 as R43-A5 requires.
realistic_gain: 0 on public and private score. It only makes the team-count denominator on the user's last finals card consistent (4 005 LB rows vs 4 003 Overview teams, a 0.05% difference). Cost: ~0 min and 0 Kaggle calls.
